# castai_impersonation_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieve the CAST AI per-organization impersonation service account used for cloud identity (e.g. for GKE impersonation onboarding).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider to retrieve the impersonation service account for (e.g. aks, gcp).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the impersonation service account
